case_number: 2025 INSC 62; CONTEMPT PETITION (C) NO. 115 OF 2019; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2703 OF 2017
summary: Contempt for non-compliance with absorption order; petition dismissed for petitioners 1-3,5; petitioner No. 4's claim refers to Registrar/Vice Chancellor for adjudication on date of birth, pay fixation, arrears; concealment of minority at appointment cited; no willful non-compliance found; directions for adjudication under 2005 SCC 129; remedy preserved for High Court challenge.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Bihar & others vs Bihar Rajya M.S.E.S.K.K.M & others (2005) 9 SCC 129
final_judgment: Contempt petition disposed of; petitioner No. 4 directed to submit claim to Registrar/Vice Chancellor by February 28, 2025; adjudication to be completed within three months; right to approach High Court preserved.
